passed_coverage: Native FORM/INPUT/submit BUTTON semantics and non-empty labels; Enter/Tab/Space/arrow/Escape defaults are not prevented on composer input, while keydown bubbling stops.
Only real submit events invoke locate; native-submit navigation prevented; busy duplicate form submissions suppressed; current text retained.
Blank submit performs no request and leaves aria-busy false.

Cancel is a visible enabled real button while busy; immediately aborts signal, releases busy UI, exposes enabled Retry, marks active steps cancelled, and announces cancellation in a polite live region.
Late locate does not overwrite cancellation; late onScene completion does not reset a newer request or publish stale Play UI.
Retry uses previous failed request without discarding a subsequently edited unsent draft.
Scene-library inputs have associated LABELs, native select/save controls, aria-describedby, polite live status, atomic summary, trimmed names, busy save guard and completion announcements.
Late scene-save response does not overwrite a newer active-scene summary/name.
Native sidebar tab buttons reference real tabpanels; ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End update roving tabindex, aria-selected, hidden/aria-hidden and invoke focus on selected tab.
Tab and modifier shortcuts retain defaults; consumed Escape is respected; panel Escape closes drawer and explicitly returns focus to toggle; toggle reopens selected panel.

audit_findings.subject: Native Enter versus preventDefault
audit_findings.finding: Composer keydown calls stopPropagation only; submit handler calls preventDefault. This avoids a duplicate keydown submit pathway. Real browser implicit Enter submission remains untested.

audit_findings.subject: Touch target dimensions
audit_findings.finding: Mobile stylesheet now declares 44px minimums for tabs/toggle, primary scene controls, scene-name/select/save, and composer input/actions/candidates. Desktop CSS permits 28px buttons and 32px library fields. These are stylesheet observations only, not verified rendered hitboxes. CSS cascade/order, clipping, zoom and real two-dimensional 44px targets still need the browser owner.

audit_findings.subject: Focus after cancellation or async button replacement
audit_findings.finding: Cancellation hides its button and reveals Retry without an explicit focus transfer; sceneSuccess replaces Play markup. Actual browser focus after the focused node hides/is removed was not tested. Verify and, if needed, intentionally focus a surviving input/Retry/Play control.

audit_findings.subject: Keyboard propagation boundary
audit_findings.finding: Composer stops bubble-phase input keydowns, but cannot block document capture-phase surface handlers. Application-shortcut guard excludes select/input/textarea, not BUTTON; no finding is claimed about actual active overlays. Test combined active surfaces and button shortcuts in integration.

audit_findings.subject: Screen-reader announcements and native focus
audit_findings.finding: Actual DOM attributes and module-issued focus changes tested. Real Tab traversal, browser default activation/Enter, assistive-technology delivery of busy/live updates, drawer visibility under CSS, and touch interaction are intentionally outside the fake DOM.

audit_findings.subject: Independent disclosure controllers
audit_findings.finding: Agent 9 reports scene-library tabs do not subscribe to existing independent panel-disclosure controllers; coordinator must centralize disclosure ownership. Isolated tab tests cannot establish synchronization in the application.
